brief: Lack of a Middle East breakthrough pushed oil and yields higher and equities lower on 28 September 2026; the 10-year Treasury yield touched above 5.25% and Fed October hike odds rose past 70%. Declines were broad but sharpest in high-beta themes: Agentic AI -250bps, Mag7 -130bps, 12-month losers -250bps, and Non-Profitable Tech -240bps, where Goldman's desk views a short as compelling given the 10-year yield has risen for seven straight months. Goldman's counter-thesis is that rates, energy and AI risks are unchanged but now better priced, shifting the distribution of pricing toward a more constructive asymmetry, and that light positioning (sentiment lowest since March, breadth lowest since the dot-com bubble, valuation at 19x matching the 10-year average) is helping insulate markets from bigger declines. Desk flow itself was quiet (activity 3 of 10, sell skew -14%), with hedge funds 24% net sellers in macro products and semis, and long-onlys 25% net sellers in macro products and TMT.
